rachats.citation: Business Combinations On December 17, 2024, NXP entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Aviva Links for $242.5 million in cash.
On January 7, 2025, NXP entered into a definitive agreement to acquire TTTech Auto for $625 million in cash.
